terms: Provided by BLM 'as is'. Cite BLM as the source of derived products; describe any modifications and do not imply BLM endorsed them; not a legal document or survey; BLM may update the data without notice.
steps: Requested GeoJSON from the layer's query service with outSR=4326 (server reprojects from NAD83 to WGS84 longitude/latitude).
Kept features whose COBCODE starts with 'OR' (the layer also holds Washington).

Added fips ('41' + the three digits of COBCODE) and name (matched to our county list); kept COBCODE as cobcode. The query asked only for COUNTY_NAME and COBCODE, so no other source attributes were requested.
Checked: exactly 36 counties, unique FIPS, name and code agree.
